A '''male Zabrak''' was a member of the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
This [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] was one of the many brought forward by [[Viscus/Legends|Brother Viscus]] to appear in front of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] for her selection of capable potential candidates to aid in her plan to get revenge against [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]]. This Zabrak was eliminated because Ventress believed he was too small so she punched him to the ground.<ref name="monster" />
